Georgia Residential Repair Contractor

You're looking for a reliable contractor to handle your residential repair needs in Georgia, and you've come to the right place. On this site, you can find information about our services, get a free quote, and learn how we can help you with your repair projects.

How We Work for Georgia Homeowners

We serve metro Atlanta and Georgia, covering areas such as Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, and many more. Our team offers 8 trades, including painting, drywall, flooring, and roofing. We provide free, written, and itemized quotes, and we respond to inquiries within one business day. Whether you need a whole-home interior repaint or a full roof replacement, we can help.

What You Get and What It Costs

Our 2026 cost guide, updated in August 2026, provides ranges for our services, such as $3,000-$8,000 for a whole-home interior repaint and $9,000-$20,000 for a full roof replacement. We advise holding back 10-15% on top of a quote for hidden issues. As a licensed and insured contractor in Georgia, you can trust that our work is done to high standards.

FAQ

What areas do you serve? We serve metro Atlanta and Georgia, covering areas such as Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, and many more. How do I get a quote? You can contact us at info@buildheritage.org or use the quote form on our site. What trades do you offer? We offer 8 trades, including packing & moving, painting, drywall, flooring & vinyl, framing, doors, window & door trim, and roofing & tiles.

Get your free quote today
